ModMetaData.name: Vandal Hearts Chase Characters
ModMetaData.author: ellerain
ModMetaData.description:
Companion for a Prepare Carefully preset. World pawns made in Prepare Carefully normally never show up again. This mod moves them into friendly factions when the game starts, and gives each of them a chance to arrive with visitor groups (including Hospitality guests) and trade caravans from their faction, so you can try to recruit them.
Chances are adjustable in Mod Settings.
